title: Mary Magdalene lands at Marseille; Merovingian bloodline

tellings.quote: Now, Mary Magdalene, according to some traditions, did travel with Joseph of Arythea, and she disembarked at the place that is now Marseilles.

plain: Mary Magdalene, according to some traditions, sailed with Joseph of Arimathea, the man who in the Gospels buries Jesus, and came ashore at what is now Marseille in France. The independent researcher Randall Carlson tells Michels this as old tradition, without naming a source. The story usually goes on to say that her descendants became the Merovingians, an early line of Frankish kings, which would mean a sacred bloodline running through European royalty.
